entries.en: Ponsonby missed his stop because he was absorbed in the last chapter.
entries.zh: 庞森比读最后一章读得入了迷，坐过了站。

entries.en: Papworth set out three bowls before realizing that the guests had cancelled dinner.
entries.zh: 帕普沃思摆出三个碗，才意识到客人们已取消了晚餐聚会。

entries.en: Gupta could play the tune after hearing it only once.
entries.zh: 古普塔只听了一遍，就能演奏那首曲子。

entries.en: Dunford was peeling an orange when the bus finally arrived.
entries.zh: 公共汽车终于到来时，邓福德正在剥橙子。

entries.en: Cecily had brought a book, but the view kept drawing her attention away from it.
entries.zh: 塞西莉带了一本书，但眼前的景色不断吸引她的注意，让她读不下去。

entries.en: We reached Aubusson with just enough time to collect the forgotten suitcase.
entries.zh: 我们到达奥布松时，刚好还来得及取回遗忘的行李箱。

entries.en: Slattery could not concentrate while someone was practising the trumpet upstairs.
entries.zh: 楼上有人练小号，斯莱特里无法集中注意力。

entries.en: Lonnie took the wrong train and arrived at the concert an hour late.
entries.zh: 朗尼坐错了火车，赶到音乐会时已经迟了一个小时。

entries.meaningZh: 客西马尼〔宗教叙事中的地点名〕
entries.en: The stage designer moved the model of Gethsemane away from the window.
entries.zh: 舞台设计师把客西马尼的模型从窗边移开。

entries.meaningZh: 杜雷克烧结石墨青铜〔商品材料名〕
entries.en: She wrapped the old Durex sample before returning it to the materials cabinet.
entries.zh: 她把那份旧杜雷克烧结石墨青铜样品包好，再放回材料柜。

entries.en: Dalby had forgotten his lines, so the director gave everyone a short break.
entries.zh: 多尔比忘了台词，导演便让大家短暂休息了一下。

entries.en: Ms Coverdale returned from the garden with wet shoes and a basket of apples.
entries.zh: 科弗代尔女士从花园回来时，鞋子湿了，还带着一篮苹果。

entries.en: Corinne counted the stitches again before deciding to undo the last row.
entries.zh: 科琳又数了一遍针数，才决定拆掉最后一行。

entries.en: Boughton liked the first sketch better than the finished painting.
entries.zh: 比起完成后的画，鲍顿更喜欢最初的素描。

entries.en: Berlusconi forgot the picnic basket but remembered the blanket and the folding chairs.
entries.zh: 贝卢斯科尼忘了带野餐篮，却记得带毯子和折叠椅。

entries.en: Seaford woke just in time to see the sun rise over the trees.
entries.zh: 西福德醒来时，正好看见太阳从树梢上方升起。

entries.en: She recognized the café in a photograph she had taken in Mantua.
entries.zh: 她认出了自己在曼图亚拍的一张照片里的咖啡馆。

entries.en: Loughton had never heard the song before, but he joined in the chorus.
entries.zh: 劳顿以前从未听过那首歌，却也跟着唱起了副歌。

entries.en: Gennady promised to bring the chessboard if someone else could bring the pieces.
entries.zh: 根纳季答应，只要有人能带棋子，他就带棋盘。

entries.en: Elkington enjoyed the walk more after he stopped checking the time.
entries.zh: 埃尔金顿不再不停看时间之后，散步也愉快多了。

entries.en: Our host in Chamonix lent us a bag for the wet clothes.
entries.zh: 在夏蒙尼接待我们的人借给我们一个袋子，用来装湿衣服。

entries.en: Brindley tried to whistle the melody, but everyone recognized a different song.
entries.zh: 布林德利试着用口哨吹那段旋律，结果大家听出的却是另一首歌。

entries.en: The museum moved the Bofors into a larger gallery before the exhibition opened.
entries.zh: 展览开幕前，博物馆把那门博福斯式高射炮移进了一个更大的展厅。

entries.en: Tippett kept a notebook beside the bed for ideas that came to him at night.
entries.zh: 蒂皮特在床边放着一本笔记本，记录夜里想到的点子。

entries.en: Onassis paused in the doorway when he heard someone playing his favourite song.
entries.zh: 奥纳西斯听到有人演奏自己最喜欢的歌，便在门口停下脚步。

entries.en: Moorfield had practised tying the knot but forgot how as soon as everyone watched him.
entries.zh: 穆尔菲尔德练习过打那个结，可大家一看着他，他就忘了怎么打。

entries.en: The scarf I had worn during my visit to Leuchars still smelled of smoke.
entries.zh: 我到访卢赫斯时戴过的那条围巾，仍然有烟味。

entries.en: We left Honiton before breakfast to collect the chairs from my parents' house.
entries.zh: 我们没吃早饭就离开了霍尼顿，去我父母家取椅子。

entries.en: Bouchard knew the answer but waited until the youngest child had finished speaking.
entries.zh: 布沙尔知道答案，但他一直等到年龄最小的孩子说完。

entries.en: Billericay had baked enough bread for the neighbours as well as his own family.
entries.zh: 比勒里基烤的面包除了够自家吃，也够分给邻居们。

entries.en: Aran laughed when the puppy fell asleep in the middle of its own game.
entries.zh: 小狗玩到一半就睡着了，阿然见了笑起来。

entries.en: Alvarez had planned a short visit but stayed until the last bus had gone.
entries.zh: 阿尔瓦雷斯本打算只待一会儿，却一直待到末班车都走了。

entries.en: Sidgwick heard the rain before noticing that the kitchen window was still open.
entries.zh: 西奇威克先听到了雨声，才注意到厨房的窗户还开着。

entries.en: Hartland was halfway home when he remembered the umbrella he had left behind.
entries.zh: 哈特兰回家走到半路，才想起自己落下的雨伞。

entries.en: Corry offered to read the smaller print aloud for those at the back.
entries.zh: 科里提出把较小字号的文字念出来，让后排的人也能听到。

entries.meaningZh: 学监的助手〔英国大学用语〕
entries.en: In the college novel, a buller waited outside while the proctor questioned the student.
entries.zh: 在那部大学题材的小说里，学监询问学生时，一名学监助手在外等候。

entries.en: Palumbo could not finish the drawing before the light began to fade.
entries.zh: 天色开始变暗前，帕伦博没能画完那幅画。

entries.en: McIvor stayed at the piano long after the other guests had gone home.
entries.zh: 其他客人回家很久之后，麦基弗还留在钢琴旁。

entries.en: Coyne had never grown tomatoes before, so the first ripe one delighted her.
entries.zh: 科因以前从未种过番茄，所以第一颗成熟的番茄让她很高兴。

entries.meaningZh: 切斯顿冒险世界〔主题公园名〕
entries.en: We had left Chessington before discovering that the camera was missing.
entries.zh: 我们离开切斯顿冒险世界后，才发现相机不见了。

entries.en: The workshop had tried CAPP, but the team wanted more time to assess it.
entries.zh: 车间试用过计算机辅助生产计划，但团队希望再多用些时间来评估。

entries.en: The room we had rented in Benfica had a little balcony overlooking the courtyard.
entries.zh: 我们在本菲卡租的房间有一个朝着庭院的小阳台。

entries.en: Skelmersdale guessed the ending, but he kept quiet until everyone had finished the book.
entries.zh: 斯凯默斯代尔猜到了结局，但在大家都读完那本书之前，一直没有透露。

entries.en: Russo could hear laughter from the kitchen while he struggled with the crossword.
entries.zh: 拉索正苦苦思索填字游戏的答案，听见厨房里传来了笑声。

entries.en: Penney had promised a quiet evening, but the neighbours arrived with a guitar.
entries.zh: 彭尼原本答应让大家安静地过一晚，邻居们却带着吉他来了。

entries.en: She kept her New Year hansel in a little wooden box beside the bed.
entries.zh: 她把自己的新年贺礼收在床边的小木盒里。

entries.en: A Veronese actor joined our rehearsal after his train arrived late.
entries.zh: 一位维罗纳演员乘坐的火车晚点了，他到达后加入了我们的排练。

entries.en: Empson remembered every face at the reunion but struggled with the names.
entries.zh: 恩普森记得重聚时每个人的面孔，名字却记得不太清楚。

entries.meaningZh: 混合〔英国方言；mell的分词形式〕
entries.en: In the old tale, she was melling flour with water when a visitor knocked.
entries.zh: 在那个老故事里，有客人敲门时，她正在把面粉与水混合。

entries.en: McKechnie meant to stay for one song but ended up listening to the entire concert.
entries.zh: 麦基奇尼本打算只听一首歌，结果听完了整场音乐会。

entries.en: Zuckerman had brought a camera, but the children wanted him in the photograph too.
entries.zh: 朱克曼带了相机，但孩子们希望他也出现在照片里。

entries.en: Ms Laski could not find her seat until someone moved a pile of coats.
entries.zh: 直到有人搬开一堆外套，拉斯基女士才找到了自己的座位。

entries.en: I left the notebook in a reading room at Carleton after the lecture.
entries.zh: 讲座结束后，我把笔记本落在了卡尔顿大学的一间阅览室。

entries.en: Ryman expected a quiet walk but met three old friends before reaching the park.
entries.zh: 赖曼本以为能安静地散步，结果还没走到公园就遇见了三个老朋友。

entries.en: Ricketts knew the old song well enough to sing it without the sheet music.
entries.zh: 里基茨对那首老歌很熟，不看乐谱也能唱出来。

entries.en: Macauley had meant to buy flowers but returned with a small lemon tree instead.
entries.zh: 麦考利本来想买花，回来时却带了一棵小柠檬树。

entries.en: Willey noticed that the old photograph had been hung upside down.
entries.zh: 威利发现那张旧照片挂倒了。

entries.en: Costain remembered the room as much larger than it looked on his return.
entries.zh: 科斯坦再次回来时，觉得房间比记忆中的小了许多。

entries.en: Corbridge refused to guess until he had seen the final piece of the puzzle.
entries.zh: 看到拼图的最后一块之前，科布里奇不肯猜。

entries.en: Roddick promised not to laugh, but the puppy's expression made that difficult.
entries.zh: 罗迪克答应不笑，但小狗的表情让他很难忍住。

entries.en: Christensen had heard the story before and noticed that its ending had changed.
entries.zh: 克里斯滕森以前听过那个故事，注意到结局变了。

entries.en: Schaffer could not hear the announcement over the noise of the approaching train.
entries.zh: 火车驶近的声音太响，谢弗听不清广播。

entries.en: Jordi enjoyed the first lesson so much that he asked to borrow the instrument.
entries.zh: 乔迪很喜欢第一堂课，便问能否借用那件乐器。

entries.en: Charteris had packed a second shirt in case the walk ended in rain.
entries.zh: 查特里斯多装了一件衬衫，以防散步到最后下起雨。

entries.en: The film's Disneyesque village had smiling animals painted on every door.
entries.zh: 影片中那个有迪斯尼影片风格的村庄，每扇门上都画着笑眯眯的动物。

entries.en: Nimmo stayed awake for the entire journey because he did not want to miss the view.
entries.zh: 尼莫一路都没睡，因为他不想错过沿途景色。

entries.en: Ms Nesbit had written the invitation by hand and drawn tiny birds in all four corners.
entries.zh: 内斯比特女士亲手写了请柬，还在四角画上了小鸟。

entries.en: Harvie could not remember the password, but he knew exactly where he had written it down.
entries.zh: 哈维想不起密码，却清楚地记得自己把它写在了哪里。

entries.en: Frederik had hoped to finish the book before the train reached the station.
entries.zh: 弗雷德里克原本希望在火车到站前读完那本书。

entries.en: Dunaway offered to stay with the dog while we collected the children.
entries.zh: 达纳韦提出在我们去接孩子们时陪着狗。

entries.en: The Darwinist in our reading group challenged the book's account of evolution.
entries.zh: 我们读书小组里的那位达尔文主义者质疑了书中对进化的解释。

entries.en: The archivist compared two translations of the same Hanseatic letter.
entries.zh: 档案管理员比较了同一封汉萨同盟书信的两种译文。

entries.en: Mr Windle looked everywhere for the glasses that were hanging from his shirt.
entries.zh: 温德尔先生到处找眼镜，其实眼镜就挂在他的衬衫上。

entries.en: Sharples had brought a list, but he still forgot the one thing we needed most.
entries.zh: 沙普尔斯带了清单，却还是忘了我们最需要的那样东西。

entries.en: Ridgway had planned to listen quietly, but the discussion soon drew him in.
entries.zh: 里奇韦本打算安静地听着，却很快参与了讨论。

entries.en: Piet found the missing photograph between two pages of his old diary.
entries.zh: 皮特在旧日记的两页之间找到了那张不见了的照片。

entries.en: Nolte had never tried the recipe before, so dinner was later than expected.
entries.zh: 诺尔蒂以前从未做过那道菜，因此晚饭比预计的晚了些。

entries.en: The seminar's discussion of irredentism became heated when two students disagreed about the same border.
entries.zh: 研讨课讨论领土收复主义时，两名学生对同一条边界看法不一，讨论变得激烈起来。

entries.en: Irvin could not sit still while he waited for the photograph to develop.
entries.zh: 欧文等照片显影时，怎么也坐不住。

entries.en: Carel had promised to bring bread, but the bakery had already closed.
entries.zh: 卡雷尔答应带面包，可面包店已经关门了。

entries.en: Ackland kept laughing whenever he tried to tell us how the picnic had gone wrong.
entries.zh: 阿克兰每次试着讲野餐是怎么出岔子的，都忍不住笑。

entries.en: The proposed Africanization of the curriculum divided the committee.
entries.zh: 那项让课程内容非洲化的提议使委员会产生了分歧。

entries.en: The Belarussian poet read her newest poem aloud before answering our questions.
entries.zh: 那位白俄罗斯诗人先朗读了自己的最新诗作，然后回答了我们的问题。

entries.en: The Yemenite novelist spoke quietly, so we moved our chairs closer.
entries.zh: 那位也门小说家说话声音很轻，于是我们把椅子挪近了些。

entries.en: In the historical novel, the boule debates the proposal long after sunset.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说里，日落很久之后，议会仍在辩论那项提议。

entries.en: Winn had brought a spare blanket for the guest who always felt cold.
entries.zh: 温给那位总觉得冷的客人多带了一条毯子。

entries.en: Steptoe remembered the tune as soon as the children began to sing.
entries.zh: 孩子们一开始唱，斯特普托就想起了曲调。

entries.en: Sagan thought the letter had been lost until it arrived with the morning post.
entries.zh: 萨根一直以为那封信丢了，直到早上的邮件送来时收到了它。

entries.en: She kept the notebook she had used while staying on Rodrigues.
entries.zh: 她留着自己在罗得里格斯岛停留时用过的那本笔记本。

entries.en: Raynes had meant to leave early, but the game continued past midnight.
entries.zh: 雷恩斯原本想早点走，但比赛一直进行到午夜以后。

entries.en: Munroe knew where the key was, but she could not reach it without a ladder.
entries.zh: 芒罗知道钥匙在哪里，但不借助梯子就够不到。

entries.meaningZh: 后外钩点冰一周跳〔花样滑冰〕
entries.en: The skater landed a single lutz, then glided towards the coach at the edge of the rink.
entries.zh: 那名滑冰者完成了一个后外钩点冰一周跳，随后滑向场边的教练。

entries.en: He shaded the juvenal feathers more lightly than the adult feathers in his drawing.
entries.zh: 他在画中把幼鸟的羽毛涂得比成鸟的羽毛更浅。

entries.en: We had just left Gstaad when I remembered the coat in the wardrobe.
entries.zh: 我们刚离开格斯塔德，我就想起了留在衣柜里的外套。

entries.en: We had planned to watch Ghostbusters, but the projector stopped working.
entries.zh: 我们本打算看《捉鬼敢死队》，但投影仪坏了。

entries.en: Gabriele had memorized the route but still brought a map in case she needed it.
entries.zh: 加布里埃莱记住了路线，但还是带着地图，以备需要。

entries.en: Our host in Bisley had left a key beneath the empty flowerpot.
entries.zh: 在比利兹接待我们的人把一把钥匙放在了空花盆下面。

entries.en: The translator set aside the letter from Ansell to check the handwritten address.
entries.zh: 译者把安思尔公司的信单独放到一旁，准备核对手写的地址。

entries.en: I recognized the doorway in a photograph I had taken in Alicante.
entries.zh: 我认出了自己在阿利坎特拍的一张照片里的门口。

entries.en: The exhibition includes drawings by an Iroquoian artist who lent us her sketchbook.
entries.zh: 展览中有一位易洛魁族艺术家的画作，她把自己的速写本借给了我们。

entries.en: Theroux had promised not to reveal the ending, and she kept her promise.
entries.zh: 泰鲁答应不透露结局，她也确实做到了。

entries.en: Susanne laughed so hard that she had to put down her cup.
entries.zh: 苏珊娜笑得太厉害，只好先把杯子放下。

entries.en: Sokolov had brought the wrong score and had to borrow the pianist's copy.
entries.zh: 索科洛夫带错了乐谱，只好借用钢琴师的那一份。

entries.en: Sachin had never seen the house before, though he recognized it from the drawings.
entries.zh: 萨钦以前从未见过那座房子，却凭那些画认出了它。

entries.en: Rievaulx found a quiet place to finish the letter before the others returned.
entries.zh: 里沃兹找了个安静的地方，好在其他人回来之前写完信。

entries.en: The parcel from Prichard contained the notebooks we had left behind.
entries.zh: 从普里查德寄来的包裹里，装着我们落下的笔记本。

entries.en: Jethro had saved the largest apple for the child who arrived last.
entries.zh: 杰思罗把最大的苹果留给了最后到的那个孩子。

entries.en: Hylton could hear the music clearly from the room where he was waiting.
entries.zh: 希尔顿在等候的房间里能清楚地听到音乐。

entries.en: Gormley had never made a kite before, but the children insisted on helping him try.
entries.zh: 戈姆利以前从没做过风筝，但孩子们坚持要帮他试一试。

entries.meaningZh: 联邦危险物品法案〔法案名〕
entries.en: The student borrowed a commentary on the FHSA for her research project.
entries.zh: 那名学生为自己的研究项目借了一本《联邦危险物品法案》评注。

entries.en: Curle remembered the smell of the garden more clearly than its colours.
entries.zh: 相比花园里的颜色，柯尔对那里的气味记得更清楚。

entries.en: Ackerman offered to take the smaller room so that the family could stay together.
entries.zh: 阿克曼提出住较小的房间，好让那一家人可以住在一起。

entries.en: Whaley had heard the story from his paternal grandfather but had never written it down.
entries.zh: 惠利从祖父那里听过那个故事，却从未把它写下来。

entries.en: The photograph showed the room we had rented in Upminster years before.
entries.zh: 照片里是我们多年前在阿普敏斯特租过的房间。

entries.en: Spinks could not see the stage until someone moved the tall vase.
entries.zh: 有人移开那只高花瓶后，斯平克斯才看得见舞台。

entries.en: Renato had hoped for sunshine, but the rain gave him time to finish his book.
entries.zh: 雷纳托原本盼着晴天，不过下雨让他有时间读完自己的书。

entries.en: Opie remembered lending the scarf to someone who had missed the last bus.
entries.zh: 奥佩记得自己把围巾借给了一个没赶上末班车的人。

entries.en: Olney had only meant to stay for tea, but the conversation lasted until dinner.
entries.zh: 奥尔尼本来只想留下喝杯茶，却一直聊到了晚饭时间。

entries.en: Norbury found the drawing much funnier after the child explained what it showed.
entries.zh: 孩子解释了画的内容之后，诺伯里觉得它好笑多了。

entries.en: She packed the unopened jar of Nescafe beside the cups and spoons.
entries.zh: 她把那罐尚未开封的雀巢咖啡与杯子、勺子放在一起打包。

entries.en: Naughton thought the room was empty until he heard someone humming behind the curtain.
entries.zh: 诺顿听到窗帘后面有人哼歌，才知道房间里有人。

entries.en: Mayle could not remember the words, so he whistled the tune instead.
entries.zh: 梅尔想不起歌词，便改用口哨吹出了曲调。

entries.en: Massimo had promised to keep the puppy off the sofa, but it was already asleep there.
entries.zh: 马西莫答应不让小狗上沙发，可它已经在沙发上睡着了。

entries.en: Hornsby liked the painting better after seeing it in the smaller room.
entries.zh: 霍恩斯比在较小的房间里看了那幅画之后，更喜欢它了。

entries.en: Hewson had forgotten the picnic, so he was surprised to see us at the gate.
entries.zh: 休森忘了野餐的事，看见我们出现在大门口时很惊讶。

entries.en: Hernando could not finish his story because everyone kept interrupting with questions.
entries.zh: 大家不断插嘴提问，埃尔南没法把自己的故事讲完。

entries.en: Frayn had heard the joke before, but he laughed as loudly as anyone.
entries.zh: 弗雷恩以前听过那个笑话，却笑得和大家一样响亮。

entries.en: An Antillean writer lent us her notebook after the reading.
entries.zh: 朗读会结束后，一位安的列斯群岛作家把自己的笔记本借给了我们。

entries.en: The coat I had worn in Regensburg still had a theatre ticket in its pocket.
entries.zh: 我在雷根斯堡穿过的那件外套，口袋里还留着一张剧院门票。

entries.meaningZh: 马特勒〔印度音乐节拍单位〕
entries.en: The teacher tapped each matra softly while the student practised the rhythm.
entries.zh: 学生练习节奏时，老师轻轻敲出每一拍。

entries.en: Laxton had planned to give away the old desk but changed his mind after repairing it.
entries.zh: 拉克斯顿本打算把旧书桌送人，修好后却改变了主意。

entries.en: Kirsten knew the children were awake because she could hear them whispering.
entries.zh: 柯尔斯顿听到孩子们在窃窃私语，知道他们还醒着。

entries.meaningZh: 国际自然保护联盟〔机构名〕
entries.en: The translator checked the handwritten note attached to the letter from IUCN.
entries.zh: 译者核对了附在国际自然保护联盟来信上的手写便条。

entries.en: Girling had never tried drawing with charcoal before and soon covered the table in dust.
entries.zh: 格林以前从未试过用炭笔画画，很快就弄得桌上满是粉末。

entries.en: Gellner could hear the children laughing but could not see what had amused them.
entries.zh: 盖尔纳听见孩子们在笑，却看不到是什么逗乐了他们。

entries.en: Darwen had meant to buy one book but came home with a bagful.
entries.zh: 达温本来只想买一本书，回家时却带了满满一袋。

entries.en: Claud was so absorbed in the jigsaw puzzle that he forgot to drink his tea.
entries.zh: 克劳德做拼图做得太入迷，忘了喝茶。

entries.en: She photographed the damaged Athey flatbed trailer before it was moved.
entries.zh: 那辆受损的阿赛平板拖车被移走前，她给它拍了照。

entries.en: Ms Wolseley could not find the invitation until she looked inside the borrowed book.
entries.zh: 沃尔斯利女士往借来的书里一看，才找到了请柬。

entries.en: Vincennes had saved the old postcards because they reminded him of his paternal grandfather.
entries.zh: 樊尚留着那些旧明信片，因为它们让他想起祖父。

entries.en: Sillitoe had meant to bring a cake, but he left it on the kitchen table at home.
entries.zh: 西利托本想带一个蛋糕来，却把它落在了家里的厨房桌上。

entries.en: The letter from Rocha included a photograph of the room where we had stayed.
entries.zh: 从罗恰寄来的信里，附着一张我们住过的房间的照片。

entries.en: Roch knew the path well enough to find the house after dark.
entries.zh: 罗奇很熟悉那条路，天黑后也能找到那所房子。

entries.en: By spring, the sleeves of his woollen jumper were already pilling.
entries.zh: 到了春天，他那件羊毛套头衫的袖子已经起球了。

entries.en: Niel had planned to photograph the garden, but the rain kept him indoors.
entries.zh: 尼尔本来想给花园拍照，却因为下雨一直待在屋里。

entries.en: Newstead could not stop laughing long enough to tell us what had happened.
entries.zh: 纽斯特德笑个不停，没法把事情的经过告诉我们。

entries.en: Mauricio had meant to return the book, but he wanted to read the last chapter again.
entries.zh: 毛利西奥原本打算还书，却又想把最后一章再读一遍。

entries.en: Martineau had never visited the house before, but its garden seemed familiar.
entries.zh: 马蒂诺以前从未来过那所房子，却觉得花园似曾相识。

entries.en: Khalil had promised to help with painting the kitchen once he had finished his homework.
entries.zh: 卡里尔答应写完作业后帮忙给厨房刷漆。

entries.en: We reached Heysham before dawn, carrying a suitcase with a broken handle.
entries.zh: 我们带着一个把手坏了的行李箱，在黎明前到达了希舍姆。

entries.en: Giuliano could not remember the title, but he described every scene in the film.
entries.zh: 朱利亚诺想不起片名，却描述了影片中的每一个场景。

entries.en: Emmerson had baked the bread himself and was eager to know what we thought.
entries.zh: 埃默森亲手烤了面包，急切地想知道我们的评价。

entries.en: She peeled a clementine while waiting for the train to leave.
entries.zh: 她一边等火车开动，一边剥着一只克莱门氏小柑橘。

entries.en: Charnwood kept looking at the clock, though he insisted that he was in no hurry.
entries.zh: 查恩伍德不停看钟，却坚称自己并不着急。

entries.en: Cosgrove had brought a map but preferred to follow the path along the stream.
entries.zh: 科斯格罗夫带了地图，却更愿意沿着溪边的小路走。

entries.en: Brotherton remembered the song from childhood but could not recall its final verse.
entries.zh: 布拉泽顿记得那首童年听过的歌，却想不起最后一段歌词。

entries.en: Tillotson had meant to stay outside, but the smell of fresh bread drew him in.
entries.zh: 蒂洛森本打算待在外面，却被新鲜面包的香味吸引进了屋。

entries.en: Symington could not open the drawer because a photograph had slipped behind it.
entries.zh: 一张照片滑到了抽屉后面，赛明顿因此打不开抽屉。

entries.en: Shuttleworth had promised to keep quiet, but he could not hide his excitement.
entries.zh: 沙特尔沃思答应保持安静，却掩饰不住自己的兴奋。

entries.en: Rawlins had brought enough tea for everyone but forgotten the cups.
entries.zh: 罗林斯带的茶够所有人喝，却忘了带杯子。

entries.en: Raquel had never seen the old album, so every photograph surprised her.
entries.zh: 拉克尔以前从未看过那本旧相册，因此每张照片都让她感到意外。

entries.en: Purdy remembered the picnic as sunny, though every photograph showed umbrellas.
entries.zh: 珀迪记得野餐那天天气晴朗，可每张照片里都出现了雨伞。

entries.en: Mr Layard had promised to bring the chess pieces, but he brought the board instead.
entries.zh: 莱亚德先生答应带棋子，结果却带来了棋盘。

entries.en: Hardcastle had planned a surprise visit, but the children saw him through the window.
entries.zh: 哈德卡斯尔本来想突然到访给大家一个惊喜，孩子们却从窗户看见了他。

entries.en: She kept the sketchbook she had used during her stay in Carnarvon.
entries.zh: 她留着自己在卡那封停留期间用过的那本速写本。

entries.en: Burrough could not find a quiet place to finish the letter until the guests had left.
entries.zh: 客人们离开后，伯勒才找到了安静的地方来写完那封信。

entries.en: Bruner had heard the tune in a dream and tried to play it before breakfast.
entries.zh: 布鲁纳在梦里听过那段旋律，早饭前便试着把它演奏出来。

entries.en: Babbage had never held a violin before and was surprised by how light it felt.
entries.zh: 巴贝奇以前从未拿过小提琴，没想到它拿在手里这么轻。

entries.en: Addington could not read the faded address without holding the envelope near the window.
entries.zh: 阿丁顿得把信封拿到窗边，才能看清那褪色的地址。

entries.en: Reinhardt had brought the wrong key, so we waited in the garden for her older sister.
entries.zh: 莱因哈特带错了钥匙，于是我们在花园里等她的姐姐来。

entries.en: Pinnock had meant to draw the house but spent the afternoon sketching its trees.
entries.zh: 皮诺克本来想画那所房子，却花了一下午画房子周围的树。

entries.en: Kelman could hear the piano from the street and stopped to listen.
entries.zh: 克尔曼从街上听到了钢琴声，便停下来听。

entries.en: She found a sketch she had made during her visit to Karnak.
entries.zh: 她找到了一幅自己到访卡纳克神庙时画的素描。

entries.en: The historian compared two translations of the Tridentine decrees before writing her introduction.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家在撰写导言前，比较了特伦托宗教会议法令的两种译文。

entries.en: Friedlander had planned to leave the concert early but stayed for the final song.
entries.zh: 弗里德兰德本打算提前离开音乐会，却一直听到了最后一首歌。

entries.en: Fahey could not reach the top shelf without standing on a chair.
entries.zh: 费伊得站到椅子上，才能够到最上面的架子。

entries.meaningZh: 埃舍利希氏杆菌属〔细菌属名〕
entries.en: The microbiologist compared photographs of Escherichia cultures from two archived studies.
entries.zh: 那位微生物学家比较了两项存档研究中埃舍利希氏杆菌属培养物的照片。

entries.en: The archivist placed the old letter from Citicorp in a protective folder.
entries.zh: 档案管理员把花旗公司寄来的那封旧信放进了保护性文件夹。

entries.en: She put the Brunton compass back in its case before opening the map.
entries.zh: 她先把Brunton袖珍罗盘放回盒里，才打开地图。

entries.en: Blakeney had promised not to ask about the present until after dinner.
entries.zh: 布莱克尼答应晚饭后再问礼物的事。

entries.en: The essay compares Petrine imagery in two paintings from the exhibition.
entries.zh: 那篇文章比较了展览中两幅画里的圣彼得意象。

entries.en: In the historical novel, a Dahomean traveller offers to guide the lost brothers home.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说里，一名达荷美旅人提出带迷路的兄弟俩回家。

entries.en: Witton had brought a spare notebook because he expected to do a great deal of sketching.
entries.zh: 威顿预计会画很多素描，因此多带了一本笔记本。

entries.en: Townend laughed at his own mistake whenever he told the story.
entries.zh: 汤恩德每次讲那个故事，都会因自己的失误而发笑。

entries.en: Soren had forgotten the picnic blanket, so we sat on our coats.
entries.zh: 苏林忘了带野餐毯，于是我们坐在自己的外套上。

entries.en: Sher could not find the page until she recognized a pressed leaf between the sheets.
entries.zh: 谢尔认出书页间那片压干的叶子，才找到了要找的一页。

entries.en: Schlegel had brought a folding chair but offered it to the guest with the sore ankle.
entries.zh: 施莱格尔带了一把折叠椅，却提出让给那位脚踝疼的客人坐。

entries.en: Samir had never seen snow before, so he stayed by the window until dark.
entries.zh: 萨米尔以前从未见过雪，因此一直在窗边待到天黑。
